query: How can I make recurring monthly or yearly top-ups conveniently via GIRO?
reference_answer: You can make small and recurring cash top-ups via GIRO by following the steps below:Step 1:Set up a GIRO arrangementStep 2: Please allow one day for your GIRO bank account to be updated in the Board's record. Thereafter, please submit a request to makerecurring cash top-ups for retirement.Please note that you must completebothsteps for recurring cash top-ups via GIRO to be successful.Currently, the online application to set up a GIRO arrangement is only available for theseparticipating banks.If you encounter any difficulties in setting up GIRO, you maywrite to usfor assistance.
answer: To make recurring monthly or yearly top-ups conveniently via GIRO, contact your service provider to set up a direct debit arrangement. This allows regular payments without manual intervention. [Document 1]
